candidates.change_summary: Delete the `depositsCount++` statement so deposits no longer increment the counter.
Replace `depositsCount++` with `depositsCount += 2` so each deposit increments the counter by two.
Invert the ownership check so that only non-owners may pass the modifier.
Remove the ownership requirement so anyone can execute guarded functions.
Withdraw a fixed amount of 0 instead of the contract's full balance.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so any caller can withdraw the whole balance.
Remove the ownership check from the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can withdraw.
Send the withdrawn funds to the contract owner instead of the calling address.
Always transfer 0 wei instead of the requested value, so withdrawal never moves funds.
